brief: Create the actual successive eyelid poses for a graceful blink by the selected cream kitten. Keep face, fur, scarf, body and limbs recognizable and steady; the eyelids genuinely close and reopen. This is source art for an actual 2D pet action, not a whole-image bob.

changes.expression: Natural feline eyelids close and reopen; do not draw improvised covering shapes over the master.

animation.start_pose: Original seated raised-paw pose with both eyes naturally open.
animation.end_pose: Return to the same open-eyed seated pose.
animation.camera: Locked frontal slight three-quarter camera; match reference face proportions.
animation.anchor_policy: Keep root position, whole-cat scale and paw ground contact stable in every cell.
phases: Eyes gently fully closed, no facial distortion.
Eyes fully open, identical stance to start.

target.placement: Website pet action source sheet, followed by transparent frame playback and encoded animation export.
